subject: Re: Partner credit governance & ops for CloudRaze Accelerator test
messages:
From: Alec Dunn <alec@cloudraze.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Holt <maya.holt@cloudraze.io>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: additional partner-sourced trial allowance for cohort Alpha

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick call. CloudRaze is ramping their next accelerator cohort and we have a cluster of SI partners that want to run 30–45 day PoCs — their expected consumption will exceed the existing promo pool. Can Redwood provide a partner-sourced top-up (not a direct discount) that is redeemable through our marketplace listings?

What we need from you to move forward:
- A short governance template (who approves, how we report usage)
- Maximum single-PO allocation and expiration rules
- Any tracking IDs we should include for Marketplace redemption

Attaching a rough cohort forecast. Happy to sync this week.

Thanks,
Alec
CloudRaze Accelerator
attachments: cohort-forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alec Dunn <alec@cloudraze.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional partner-sourced trial allowance for cohort Alpha

Hi Alec — thanks for the details and the forecast. Looping in Ben (partner ops) and Kimberly (marketplace) to validate operational feasibility, and Soojin to confirm SI cofunding rules.

At a high level, Redwood can support a partner-sourced allowance that:
- Issues promo codes bound to a HubSpot deal + external partner id
- Expires 60 days after activation date (can shorten to 30 for time-boxed cohorts)
- Is capped per-PO and per-customer (we recommend $8k max per PO for this cohort given token burn estimates)

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to confirm process for escrow-style credits and PO acceptance.
2) Kimberly to confirm listing/payment flow on the marketplace and whether codes can be SKU-restricted.
3) Provide a 1-page governance template (attached draft) that CloudRaze can share with SIs and sponsors.

If that works I’ll prepare an approval email template to get legal/finance buy-in.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | (555) 555-0123
attachments: CR-credits-term-sheet.pdf (draft governance)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Alec Dunn <alec@cloudraze.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional partner-sourced trial allowance for cohort Alpha

Nice summary, Tessa. Operational notes from Partner Ops:

- We can set up an escrowed credit pool tied to CloudRaze with a single redemption namespace. Credits will be consumed against per-tenant usage; we can enforce per-PO and per-customer caps.
- Recommended initial allocation: $120,000 total pool, max $8,000 per PO, 60-day activation window, 90-day total expiration for unused balances.
- Billing/legal: we require a simple signed appendum to the partner terms (see attached term sheet).

I’ve attached a sample allocation workbook that maps cohort slots to expected consumption. If CloudRaze signs off we’ll need:
- Purchase order referencing deal DW-56912
- Contact for TrexOps (for redemption reconciliation)

Ben
Head, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed-allocation-queue.xlsx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alec Dunn <alec@cloudraze.io>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional partner-sourced trial allowance for cohort Alpha

Thanks — quick note from the SI partnership side:
- SIs in this cohort are cofunding 25% of infra spend (confirmed) so Redwood’s sponsored credits will be treated as promotional top-ups on top of SI cofunding.
- We should include two guardrails in governance: (1) one redemption per SI per customer, (2) mandatory post-trial survey that reports key success metrics (latency, cost delta, product fit).

I’m ok with the $8k per-PO cap but would like to pilot with 10 slots first (total $80k) to validate consumption patterns before scaling to the full $120k.

— Soojin
Strategic Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Alec Dunn <alec@cloudraze.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Holt <maya.holt@cloudraze.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional partner-sourced trial allowance for cohort Alpha

All good on our side — CloudRaze signs up for the pilot allocation: 10 slots / $8k per PO, total $80k. We’ll issue a PO referencing DW-56912 by end of day tomorrow and will include a TrexOps contact (Olivia Nash).

A few operational asks from CloudRaze:
- Can promo codes be limited to the accelerator SKU and be redeemable only during the cohort window?
- We prefer a DocuSign flow for the term appendum.

Appreciate the fast turnaround. If you can share the one-pager governance and the allocation workbook as final PDFs I’ll route them to our finance team.

Best,
Alec
CloudRaze Accelerator
attachments: PO-draft-placeholder.docx (placeholder)
